name: words-of-yeshua
description: A Christ-centred, local-first Bible reader and study companion for exploring the words of Yeshua in scriptural context.
author: Words of Yeshua

scripts.dev: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && cmake-js compile --directory native --runtime electron --runtime-version 43.3.0 --arch x64 && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/launch-electron.cjs ."
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/launch-electron.cjs .
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint src electron scripts data/words-of-yeshua vite.config.ts electron-builder.config.cjs eslint.config.js
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && vitest run
scripts.package: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && cmake-js compile --directory native --runtime electron --runtime-version 43.3.0 --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --win
scripts.make: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && cmake-js compile --directory native --runtime electron --runtime-version 43.3.0 --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
scripts.make:portable: node scripts/generate-biblical-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-biblical-content.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && cmake-js compile --directory native --runtime electron --runtime-version 43.3.0 --arch x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win zip
